data_fields.name: filter_reveal_modes
data_fields.donor_constant: 7 (all, mines, heroes, towns, artifacts, resources, visible only)

best_idea: A minimap that is a per-tile colour raster painted over fog of war with category reveal filters, scaled by an integer-friendly zoom, with a viewport box and click-to-centre, so the player always sees the known world and nothing hidden.
decision_why: Keep the raster, the fog gate, the category filters and click-to-centre; the reveal must come from the server (client gets only what the player may see) and zone size comes from zone data; replace the assert-only zoom check with a load-time clamp.
acceptance: On a 375 px phone the zone minimap is a square at the top corner; unexplored tiles are black; a hero or shrine appears only after its tile is known or when its category filter is on; a tap re-centres the view on that tile; a 36-tile zone draws each tile as a 4 by 4 block; the viewport box shrinks as the zone grows; a 200-tile zone fails at load with a clear message.
